odoo-brl.notes: BRL engine: chunked 4-way classify (double-profile check_module_exists) + deterministic cost (cost-config.json) + RTM deliverables. Phase 0 bootstrap uses profile_inspect(summary) for profile composition; Phase C uses impact_analysis to ground Extension-M/L tier in real blast radius. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-addon-diff.notes: CE/EE/distribution diff is profile-scoped: pin profile (set_active_profile) + profile_inspect(repos) to know each profile's real repo coverage; entity_lookup attributes a field's source module (CE vs EE). min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-campaign-plan.notes: Standalone-first. OSM tools optional for feature claim grounding only; profile_inspect verifies a 'competitive displacement' angle against the real platform inventory.

odoo-capability-proof.notes: module_inspect(summary) adds architecture scope (N models/views) to the proof package beyond field-level evidence; profile_inspect(repos) grounds index coverage (absence-in-index transparency); describe_module attributes module identity (author/shortdesc). min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-coding.notes: Front-door coding orchestrator (spawner) - stays light on tools: it scopes the modules and orders them, then dispatches one odoo-coder coordinator per module (heavy per-module OSM localization happens inside the coders / odoo-test-writer, not here). set_active_version pins ONE concrete series for the whole run; module_inspect(dependencies) builds the module DAG that batches the waves (SSOT skills/_shared/odoo-module-graph.md). find_override_point (>=3-entry override chain) + impact_analysis (wide downstream ripple) are the tier-classification signals that gate the opus row. The coverage pre-flight grounds the test scope before dispatch and forwards it into the odoo-test-writer brief: tests_covering (TestMethods already covering the model -> additive-only), test_coverage_audit (fields with zero/partial coverage), test_base_classes (base class + cr.commit()-forbidden contract). min_server 0.15.0 for the test-surface tools (tests_covering/test_coverage_audit).

odoo-competitive-brief.notes: Standalone-first. profile_inspect turns the capability matrix's 'your platform' column from training-data assertion into indexed fact. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-content-draft.notes: Standalone-first. OSM tools optional for grounding feature claims in content.

odoo-customization-inventory.notes: profile_inspect(modules) enumerates the profile's modules in one call (Round 0); module_inspect(dependencies) + find_deprecated_usage ground upgrade-risk in real dependency graph + deprecated-API scan. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-deal-followup.notes: Standalone-first. check_module_exists optional - only when user requests feature fact-check.

odoo-demo-recording.notes: Standalone-first. OSM optional - only to plan the demo click path; video capture is browser-MCP side. set_active_version pins the target version so view/URL paths are not resolved against latest-indexed.

odoo-deploy-checklist.notes: Domain 5 grounds CLI flags for the target version via cli_help (was instructed in SKILL.md but undeclared).

odoo-deprecation-audit.notes: set_active_profile scopes find_deprecated_usage(profile_name) to the customer's modules instead of default Odoo CE scope. test_base_classes detects deprecated/removed test base class usage across the framework's version windows; js_test_inspect surfaces deprecated QUnit patterns in v18+ modules. min_server 0.15.0 for test tools.

odoo-discovery-summary.notes: Standalone-first. profile_inspect(modules) verifies profile-owned modules in one call (Round 3.5), upgrading Confidence-Low rows. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect. `set_active_profile`/`model_inspect`/`lint_check` appear ONLY in the SKILL.md's explicit 'Do NOT call' line (developer-oriented tools out of scope for this business-analysis skill) - intentionally left undeclared, not a registry gap.

odoo-feature-check.notes: profile_inspect(repos) grounds index coverage (absence-in-index transparency); describe_module attributes module identity (author/shortdesc). min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-feature-highlights.notes: module_inspect(summary) gives concrete architecture numbers (N models/views) for marketing copy.

odoo-frontend-design.notes: Knowledge-only design-quality skill (leaf, no agent spawn): the senior-frontend-designer expertise that odoo-solution-design (architect) and odoo-coding (coder) LOAD for the UI/UX of a change, and the quality bar odoo-ui-review rates against. resolve_stylesheet + find_style_override ground design decisions in the target version's real theme tokens; it points to skills/_shared/odoo-frontend-fidelity.md as the SSOT for the verification mechanics rather than restating them. min_server 0.7.0 for the stylesheet tools.

odoo-gap-analysis.notes: module_inspect distinguishes Configuration vs Extension via view/JS inventory, not just the field list; profile_inspect(repos) grounds index coverage (absence-in-index transparency); describe_module attributes module identity (author/shortdesc). min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-git-rebase.notes: Same-series rebase orchestrator (pure delegation): subagents read diffs + compare behavior; model_inspect/entity_lookup ground replayed symbols at the NEW BASE HEAD to catch rename/move/already-present absorption failures git does not flag; find_override_point checks refactored override points; test tools ground test-survival at the shared series. cli_help grounds odoo-bin flags for the CONDITIONAL P10 odoo-instance dispatch. No cross-version api_version_diff (same series) - the SKILL.md line saying so ('do NOT call cross-version api_version_diff') is an explicit negative instruction, not a registry gap, and stays undeclared. min_server 0.15.0 for test tools.

odoo-objection-handling.notes: module_inspect(summary) strengthens the ACA Counter table with module scope numbers.

odoo-override-finding.notes: lookup_core_api + api_version_diff verify a method's API stability / signature change from the index; find_examples grounds the override template in real indexed code instead of training memory.

odoo-solution-design.notes: Slim SKILL.md for the design bundle - companion to the odoo-solution-architect agent. Designs the technical solution (approach / data model / override strategy / module structure) before any code is written. impact_analysis grounds blast-radius in Risks; find_override_point grounds super() position; validate_* verify the proposed ORM chains so the coder inherits a verified design. test_base_classes/find_test_examples/tests_covering/test_coverage_audit ground test outline in real test surface (PR #323, v0.15.0). min_server 0.15.0 for test tools.

odoo-planning.notes: Slim SKILL.md for the planning bundle - companion to the odoo-planner agent. Turns an APPROVED design DAG into the 3-block EXECUTION PLAN (wave-batched module-DAG + integration cadence + module/stage->skill wiring + full lifecycle), conforming to plan-mode-schema.md; it does NOT serialize run-<id>.json (intake Phase P owns that). Stays LIGHT on tools: set_active_version pins the series (also a reachability probe); module_inspect(dependencies) + check_module_exists trust-but-verify that the modules the design DAG names exist and their dependency edges hold before batching into waves - the planner CONSUMES the design DAG by pointer, it does not re-derive it. min_server 0.6.0.

odoo-pr-monitoring.notes: Post-PR lifecycle owner (poller; NOT a blocking DAG node). Stays LIGHT on tools - it makes essentially no OSM calls: all PR/CI/review reads + the merge are GitHub-API ops routed through git-toolkit's `git-ops` skill, post-merge cleanup is likewise routed through `git-ops`, and deep source grounding happens INSIDE the odoo-debug / odoo-coding it routes to. set_active_version pins the run's target Odoo series once at attach (doubling as the OSM reachability probe) so the version-pinned context travels with any D3 hand-off to odoo-debug and into the merge report. Writes only its own poll-state under <ISOLATE_DIR>/pr-monitoring/ (gitignored); the PR URL lives in run-<id>.json (run-harness owns that write) so a fresh session can re-attach to the watch. min_server 0.6.0 for set_active_version.

odoo-risk-overview.notes: profile_inspect(modules) auto-enumerates the in-scope modules in Round 0. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-intake.notes: Mostly text routing and brainstorm, but NOT MCP-tool-free: Phase R explicitly allows read-only OSM calls (model_inspect/check_module_exists/find_override_point/impact_analysis) during optional recon, and the version/profile-unknown path (reached when no rung of the project-facts ladder resolves them) directly calls list_available_versions -> list_available_profiles -> profile_inspect to resolve and confirm a profile for the current turn. Corrects a stale note that claimed zero MCP calls. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect. No SKILL.md '## MCP tools' block is generated here - odoo-intake is in gen_surface.py SKIP_SKILL_DIRS by design.

odoo-ui-review.notes: Rendered-UI review (aesthetics/functional/stability/a11y/performance). Browser MCP (chrome-devtools) captures the live screen; OSM grounds findings in code. find_examples shows how a given view type is typically structured (Step 1b screen-shape recon); impact_analysis maps the template/asset-bundle inheritance blast radius so a finding names what a fix could break elsewhere. Tool list synced to companion agent agents/odoo-ui-reviewer.md. find_examples (v0.1.0) + impact_analysis (v0.1.0) are core tools below the 0.7.0 stylesheet floor, so the floor is unchanged.

odoo-version-diff.notes: find_examples grounds Added-API descriptions in real indexed usage.

odoo-visual-regression.notes: Screenshot baseline + diff between two states/builds. OSM scopes the comparison via blast radius; browser MCP captures and diffs. resolve_stylesheet adds the @import-chain blast radius; set_active_version pins the target version. list_available_versions backs the OSM-side version menu when no rung of the project-facts ladder resolves the series.

odoo-support-triage.notes: Composition skill - no MCP tools called directly. NL-dispatches to odoo-debug (bug path) and odoo-feature-check (feature-request path) via description-match. All outputs to <ISOLATE_DIR>/support/ (gitignored, confidentiality-safe).

odoo-qa-suite.notes: Phase 1 grounds test mechanics (test class, tag syntax, --test-enable/--test-tags) via OSM set_active_version + cli_help for the target version; Phase 2 NL-dispatches to odoo-deploy-checklist. Outputs to <ISOLATE_DIR>/qa/. Test inventory pre-flight (before Phase 1): tests_covering + test_coverage_audit establish the anti-reinvention coverage baseline; test_base_classes grounds the cr.commit()-forbidden base-class menu before any TransactionCase/HttpCase row; js_test_inspect grounds the per-module JS framework (hoot/qunit/tour) for frontend modules. min_server 0.15.0 for the test-surface tools (was 0.8.0 - too low for these).

run-harness.notes: Drive-to-done loop: walks the RUN-DAG in <ISOLATE_DIR>/run-<id>.json, dispatches each node, reads its Continuation Contract, advances to DONE/BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT. Pure orchestration - no MCP tools of its own.

odoo-test-writing.notes: Writes executable Odoo test files (TransactionCase/Form or Hoot/QUnit per version); tests protect business behavior, not current code. test_base_classes resolves the correct base class + cr.commit()-forbidden contract per version (incl. HttpCase for tour/url_open); test_class_inspect resolves an extended test-helper's base chain + cursor contract (Round 2); find_test_examples returns test-only chunks (no production contamination) for the grounded pattern; js_test_inspect confirms the per-module JS framework mix (QUnit vs Hoot) + suite paths + tour registry before any JS/tour test is emitted. tests_covering + test_coverage_audit establish the anti-reinvention coverage baseline (Round 2.5); model_inspect/resolve_orm_chain/validate_relation/validate_depends ground field names + relational chains + @api.depends paths (Rounds 2/5); api_version_diff grounds the adapt-mode (forward-port) renamed/removed-API mapping; cli_help confirms the -i/-u/--test-enable/--skip-auto-install flag set for the series under test before the run. min_server 0.15.0 for the test-surface tools (tests_covering/test_coverage_audit/test_class_inspect).

odoo-security-audit.notes: Audits Odoo code for security issues (SQLi/XSS/access-control/CSRF/deserialization/secrets); graded findings report, no fix.

odoo-data-migration.notes: Writes Odoo pre/post-migration scripts + verification plan; does NOT execute against an instance (that is a separate human-gated deploy step).

odoo-perf-audit.notes: Audits Odoo code for performance anti-patterns (N+1, missing prefetch, unindexed domains, compute thrash); findings + remediation.

odoo-pricing-proposal.notes: Builds a customer-facing pricing proposal (license tier + implementation cost bands + SLA + terms); rate numbers are AE-filled placeholders, not hardcoded.

odoo-rfp-response.notes: Rates Odoo compliance per RFP requirement into a Yes/Partial/Roadmap/No matrix with evidence + executive fit summary; module_inspect adds view/flow coverage to distinguish Yes vs Partial; profile_inspect(repos) grounds index coverage (absence-in-index transparency); describe_module attributes module identity; suggest_pattern backs the No path. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-customer-health.notes: Assesses an existing Odoo customer's health (score + churn risk + upsell + next-touch) for customer-success/retention.

odoo-debug.notes: Front-door debug orchestrator. Stays light on tools - pins version + quick layer classification, then dispatches specialist debug agents (odoo-backend-debugger OSM-only; odoo-ui-debugger browser, serial-exclusive). Heavy OSM localization happens inside the agents. test_base_classes checks for cr.commit() misuse in test context; tests_covering locates existing tests covering the failing model. Writes run notes to <ISOLATE_DIR>/debug/ (gitignored). min_server 0.15.0 for test tools.

odoo-forward-port.notes: Forward-port orchestrator: api_version_diff grounds version-boundary breaks and outcome classification; model_inspect/entity_lookup verify symbol survival at target to catch autosilent field breaks; find_override_point assists in locating insertion points during adapt phase. test_base_classes/find_test_examples/tests_covering/test_coverage_audit ground test verification at target version (PR #323, v0.15.0). cli_help grounds odoo-bin flags for the P9 per-batch odoo-instance dispatch; impact_analysis derives the P9 reverse-closure verify scope directly (no pre-built dependency DAG file the way odoo-modules-upgrade has). min_server 0.15.0 for test tools.

odoo-i18n.notes: Spawner: dispatches odoo-translator for .pot/.po via odoo-bin (no polib); the diff-review + commit are git-ops. OSM only for version flags. cli_help grounds the per-series CLI surface - the --i18n-export/--load-language/-u reload server flags (v8-v18) vs the odoo-bin i18n subcommand (loadlang/export/import, v19+); --load-language loads the existing .po into the DB so the re-export reproduces its msgstr (distinct from --language/-l which only selects the file). entity_lookup confirms a field's canonical string label for glossary alignment. There is no OSM i18n tool - the leaf re-exports via shell odoo-bin; the skill delegates the diff-review + commit to git-toolkit:git-ops.

odoo-doc-illustration.notes: Spawner: dispatches odoo-user-doc-writer (userguide RST) and odoo-marketing-writer (App-Store landing HTML) per DOC LAYER; pre-fetches copy from odoo-content-draft on the marketing path; scoped via odoo-doc-scoper; scheduled via odoo-doc-planner. cli_help resolves the exact install/reinstall flags (--with-demo, per-locale load, --skip-auto-install) at runtime for the pre-capture provisioning precondition this skill verifies.

odoo-instance.notes: Spawner: dispatches odoo-instance-ops agent for instance lifecycle (create/drop/init/update/test). cli_help grounds per-version odoo-bin CLI flags; set_active_version pins the target series for OSM calls; list_available_versions lets the skill discover indexed versions when the user specifies a vague target. check_module_exists + set_active_profile + profile_inspect ground the dispatched agent's data-driven unions (Viindoo to_base into --load; test_lint/test_pylint into the test-run install set) against the active profile. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-modules-upgrade.notes: Cross-major cluster upgrade orchestrator (full delegation; CODE-LEVEL, no data migration): validate_depends + module_inspect(dependencies) build the topo DAG; subagents compare custom-vs-core and adapt; reuses odoo-deprecation-audit + odoo-version-diff (recon), odoo-gap-analysis (core-absorption), odoo-coding (adapt), odoo-instance (install/test), and the plugin review capability (PR). Module wholly absorbed -> delete + record reason. cli_help grounds per-target odoo-bin flags. min_server 0.15.0.

odoo-acceptance.notes: Acceptance orchestrator (spawner-agent) - stays light on tools: set_active_version pins the series once (also a reachability probe) and impact_analysis grounds the Phase 0 verify-scope manifest via reverse-closure blast radius. Phase 0 also calls module_inspect(dependencies) + model_inspect(views) (via acceptance-scope.md) to enumerate the affected screens before the planner runs. Deep structural grounding happens inside the dispatched agents (odoo-qa-planner / odoo-qa-tester), not here; live execution runs against a real instance + browser MCP (not OSM). Phase 2 SKILL.md names cli_help as the per-series odoo-bin flag grounding the odoo-instance dispatch performs (documented here for the same reason all other cli_help-via-odoo-instance orchestrators declare it - odoo-git-rebase, odoo-forward-port, odoo-doc-illustration, odoo-modules-upgrade, odoo-i18n, odoo-instance, odoo-deploy-checklist). min_server 0.6.0 for set_active_version (impact_analysis/cli_help 0.1.0, module_inspect/model_inspect 0.5.0 in the surface).

odoo-icon-design.notes: Spawner: dispatches odoo-icon-designer to design and generate the module identity icon (icon.png / icon.svg on v19). Standalone-first; OSM optional for category/version grounding. Browser-free; no live instance required. min_server 0.13.1 for describe_module.

odoo-doc-feature-map.notes: Spawner: dispatches odoo-feature-cataloger to enumerate all features/capabilities a module ships for documentation purposes. Standalone-first; browser-free. OSM for module capability enumeration (describe_module + module_inspect + model_inspect). min_server 0.13.1 for describe_module.

odoo-doc-walkthrough.notes: Spawner: dispatches odoo-doc-scenarist to author happy-path usage scenarios for module documentation. Standalone-first; browser-free (scenarios authored without a live instance). OSM for grounding scenario steps in real UI labels/views. min_server 0.6.0 for set_active_version.

odoo-test-writer.notes: Context-isolated executor that AUTHORS Odoo automation tests by invoking the odoo-test-writing skill INLINE (Skill tool, +0 depth) - a HARD LEAF that spawns no agent. Same tool surface as odoo-test-writing (it delegates the grounded authoring to that skill): test_base_classes/test_class_inspect resolve base classes + cursor contract; find_test_examples returns test-only chunks; js_test_inspect confirms the per-module JS framework mix + tour registry; tests_covering + test_coverage_audit set the anti-reinvention coverage baseline; model_inspect/resolve_orm_chain/validate_relation/validate_depends ground fields + relational chains + @api.depends; api_version_diff grounds adapt-mode renamed/removed-API mapping. Launched by odoo-coder (test-first teammate), odoo-acceptance (P2a durable tour/HttpCase), odoo-code-review (coverage gate), odoo-forward-port / odoo-git-rebase (adapt-mode test translation). Returns the authored RED test file paths. min_server 0.15.0 for the test-surface tools.

odoo-diff-comparator.notes: Read-only diff-range comparator: reads a whole-cluster or per-module git diff and emits a structured nghiệp vụ / intent / expected-outcome / acceptance-criteria comparison between two branches (rebase) or between a custom module and new-version core (upgrade). Writes only its findings file; no further spawn. Reused by odoo-git-rebase (P3 cluster comparison + P10 verify) and odoo-modules-upgrade (P2 core-absorption).

odoo-installable-prober.notes: Read-only forward-port pipeline leaf: resolves the target-series installable state for a single module by reading the target clean-tip __manifest__.py the orchestrator wrote (manifest_path, REQUIRED - the flag is a per-file manifest fact, not an indexed-graph fact), plus the source manifest history dump for the category-3 transition. OSM is used only as a reachability probe. No writes, no further spawns.

odoo-instance-ops.notes: Instance lifecycle leaf agent: learns per-version odoo-bin CLI flags at runtime via cli_help; set_active_version pins the target series; list_available_versions used for version resolution when target is vague. check_module_exists (+ set_active_profile / profile_inspect to pin and confirm the active profile) grounds two build-time HARD RULES: union Viindoo to_base into --load when present, and union present test_lint/test_pylint into the test-run install set. Does NOT call OSM for code-structure queries otherwise - only for CLI surface + module-presence discovery. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-gap-analyzer.notes: Gap-analysis leaf worker: dispatched by the odoo-gap-analysis skill (one per requirement cluster) to classify Configuration vs Extension and ground coverage in OSM; mirrors the skill's tool set. min_server 0.13.1 for profile_inspect.

odoo-qa-planner.notes: Acceptance oracle author (leaf, no spawn): set_active_version pins the series, then model_inspect / entity_lookup / module_inspect confirm that the fields, views, labels, state values, and role groups its scenarios reference actually EXIST for the version. OSM is STATIC - used only to keep the oracle well-formed, NEVER to infer the business expected (that comes from the requirement). min_server 0.6.0 for set_active_version.

odoo-qa-tester.notes: Live acceptance executor (leaf, no spawn): set_active_version pins the series, then model_inspect / entity_lookup confirm a screen's real fields/views/labels/state values before driving it. OSM is STATIC structural grounding only; live record values come from the running instance + browser MCP (and a live Odoo MCP exposing read_record/search_records), not OSM. min_server 0.6.0 for set_active_version.

odoo-icon-designer.notes: Icon design leaf agent: generates module identity icon as SVG then rasterizes to PNG; version-gated emit (PNG-only v8-v18; +icon.svg+manifest key on v19); style-era-aware (skeuo v8-v10, flat v11-v16, flat-shadow v17-v19); standalone-first, browser-free. OSM optional for category/version grounding. min_server 0.13.1 for describe_module.

odoo-feature-cataloger.notes: Feature-inventory leaf agent: enumerates all capabilities a module ships for documentation. Browser-free; standalone-first. OSM-primary (describe_module + module_inspect + model_inspect); disk fallback for ACL/security. Produces feature-catalog.jsonl + feature-catalog.md. min_server 0.13.1 for describe_module.

odoo-doc-scenarist.notes: Doc-scenario leaf agent: authors happy-path usage scenarios (narrative + structured steps[]) for module documentation. Browser-free; standalone-first; NOT bound by acceptance-oracle-contract.md. OSM for grounding scenario steps in real UI labels/views. Produces walkthrough.jsonl + walkthrough.md. min_server 0.6.0.

odoo-doc-scoper.notes: Multi-module scope mapper (mirrors odoo-review-scoper pattern): walks manifests under TARGET, enumerates modules, resolves languages (5-tier + disk-union), detects doc_layer capability, records has_demo. Emits a scope block + modules[] list. Read-only on source; writes only scope block file. min_server 0.13.1 for describe_module.

odoo-doc-planner.notes: reuses _shared/doc-cluster-plan.md; standalone-first, OSM optional; writes doc-plan.yaml

odoo-user-doc-writer.notes: End-user guide writer: browser-exclusive leaf agent dispatched by odoo-doc-illustration; captures userguide screenshots + assembles doc/index.rst (and per-locale variants); audience = end user, task-guidance tone; never spawns. OSM grounds UI labels via model_inspect.

odoo-marketing-writer.notes: App-Store landing writer: browser-exclusive leaf agent dispatched by odoo-doc-illustration; captures hero/feature-grid screenshots + assembles static/description/index.html (and per-locale variants) from supplied marketing copy + feature-catalog.jsonl + app-store-template.md; wires manifest images + store-keys audit; never spawns. describe_module for manifest summary. min_server 0.13.1.

orchestration._doc: SSOT (single source of truth) for orchestration metadata of every skills/<dir>. Consumed by gen_surface.py -> docs/reference/ORCHESTRATION-MAP.md + orchestration-digest.txt, and validated by check_orchestration.py. spawn_class: leaf (runs inline) | orchestrator-nl (chains other skills via natural-language dispatch; no subagent spawn of its own - a skill's own spawns cell may still list an anonymous review/resolver subagent) | spawner-agent (dispatches a subagent). stack: backend | frontend | fullstack | none (drives backend<->frontend routing). instance_touching: a FACT about the skill, not a tier lever - true when the skill's OWN procedure drives a live instance (calls the allocator lease API, dispatches the odoo-instance skill / odoo-instance-ops agent, or emits odoo-bin), false when it only ROUTES an instance need away (a NEEDS_NEXT hand-off, an Out-of-Scope row). Declared true, it must ground CLI via OSM cli_help per target version. check_orchestration.py's [instance-truth] rule reads the skill's own SKILL.md body and contradicts this field when the evidence disagrees, so the value can no longer be whatever tier its author wanted. output_mode: chat-only (emits to chat, skip Plan Mode) | writes-files (persists file artifact, requires Plan Mode); SSOT here, replaces hardcoded chat-only lists. default_gate_tier: L0 (read-only/chat auto-pass) | L1 (writes $ODOO_AI_HOME/ internal - auto-pass under --auto) | L2 (irreversible/outward: an outward git merge/push or a shared instance_touching - ALWAYS human gate; dial cannot lower). run-harness's OWN between-wave integration advance is L1 (autonomous drive-to-done: instance touches are ephemeral test DBs; each wave auto-advances on a GREEN cumulative close-gate with NO per-wave PR, and the only irreversible landing is the downstream outward merge of the single run-level PR the terminal integrate land-tail opens once after the final wave - a fresh non-force first push, not a gate); a DYNAMIC unplanned node (including a wave) stays L2 via run-harness's all-dynamic-L2 rule - neither is a registry default_gate_tier value (a run-harness node tier, not a skill field). Per-node override lives in run-<id>.json, not here. handoff: Context-Handoff Protocol tier for resuming subagents across turns. send-message (Tier-A: a launcher resumes a child it launched, by the id its own launch returned, avoiding cold-spawn overhead) | fork (Tier-B: subagent_type=fork fan-out inheriting parent context + prompt cache) | fresh (Tier-C default: cold-spawn every turn via a fresh agent launch + worklog blackboard - the always-correct baseline). Absence of the field is treated as fresh by the lint rule; only declare when the skill is wired for Tier-A or Tier-B in snippets/context-handoff-protocol.md.

spawns: (Phase R: ≤2 read-only recon agents - Explore or specialist in read-only mode; no writes, no further spawn)

(anonymous read-only fan-out subagents, explicit model per phase haiku/sonnet/opus; read-only on Odoo source, write only findings under <SHARE_DIR>/survey/, no further spawn - see skills/_shared/concurrency-guard.md Mode B)
(conditional DAG workers when >10 large clusters)

odoo-coder (per-module COORDINATOR - launched for EVERY module; the sanctioned nested spawner that owns the module's INTERNAL work-item split, launches odoo-backend-coder / odoo-frontend-coder per WI, sequences backend-before-frontend, tests the integrated module via odoo-instance INLINE, and returns files for odoo-coding to commit - a nested spawner-coordinator one level below odoo-coding)
odoo-test-writer (hard leaf - launched FIRST by the odoo-coder coordinator per WI to author the RED test, before the coder makes it green; authors by invoking the odoo-test-writing skill inline)
odoo-backend-coder (hard leaf - launched by the odoo-coder coordinator for a backend work-item)
odoo-frontend-coder (hard leaf - launched by the odoo-coder coordinator for a frontend work-item)
(dispatch: ONE odoo-coder per module; model-weighted subagent batches, explicit model per module per tier table haiku/sonnet/opus/fable - see skills/_shared/concurrency-guard.md Mode B)
odoo-code-reviewer
